description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Dalmascan Captain], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Fire, Holy)] and [Breaker Knight Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dalmascan Captain
description.text: Holy and Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Fire, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Holy] after using a Fire/Holy ability

description.name: Breaker Knight Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Destructive Slash after using two Fire or Holy abilities
